_doc: Per plate decisions for scripts/register/bodies/cut_bodies.py, each with its reason. layer = the PSD layer that is the bare body; psd = a master PSD found under a different name; kit = use the kit lane's cut body layer; sibling = no usable photo for this glass, so geometry comes from another glass of the same body and material from the reference glass; exclude = not a glass body we can cut.

boston-round-30ml-20-400|Clear.why: the largest layer is a white fill; Layer 22 is the bottle

boston-round-60ml-20-400|Clear.why: Layer 11 is the bottle; the cap sits beside it

circle-100ml-18-415|Clear.why: the dip tube runs past the canvas edge and won the baseline test

cylinder-30ml-18-415|Clear.exclude: the fixed 30 ml spray pair (a matrix exception): bottle and sprayer are one piece in the PSD and no kit body layer exists

boston-round-60ml-20-400|Amber.why: the Amber PSD holds only the cap; the body is flattened into the background

boston-round-60ml-20-400|Cobalt Blue.why: the Cobalt PSD holds only the cap; the body is flattened into the background

bell-10ml-13-415|Clear.why: the catalogue sells it as 10 ml; the master library files it as Bell 12 ml (flagged)

cream-jar-3ml-20mm|Cobalt Blue.why: CJ3Blue.psd holds the jar flattened into the background; geometry from the Clear 3 ml jar, cobalt from the reference glass

cream-jar-60ml-58mm|Frosted.exclude: plastic, not glass: the library names it Cream Jar Frost Plastic 60ml

lotion-bottle-30ml-18mm|Clear.exclude: metal-clad bottle: the sleeve and pump are one merged layer, no bare glass

lotion-bottle-30ml-no-neck|Clear.exclude: bottle and gold pump are one merged layer, no bare glass

lotion-bottle-3ml-Snap-On|Clear.exclude: sample vial and sprayer are one merged layer, no bare glass

royal-14ml-11mm|Clear.exclude: decorative bottle and gold cap are one merged layer, no bare glass

pillar-9ml-17-415|Clear.exclude: no master PSD; the only Pillar file is the 13-415 roll-on

vial-3ml-13-425|Blue.exclude: no master PSD under any name (GBVBlu1o9)

vial-3ml-13-425|Green.exclude: no master PSD under any name (GBVGreen2o4)
